Malaysia's energy efficiency and emissions intensity for public low cost housing is high.
the Malaysian public low cost houses have a high BEI, and that the BEI is higher in the case study of the 1990s project than the 2000s project.
the Malaysian government needs to establish mandatory building energy performance codes for new residential construction and retrofits of existing buildings.

the building operation phase is an important component of GHG emissions, and that the building operation energy and emission intensity can be improved by implementing energy efficiency strategies.
